system.description:
The Solar's attack is delivered with such speed and subtlety that witnesses cannot determine its origin. After making an attack supplemented by this Charm, any observer who did not already know the character was attacking must succeed on a (Wits + Awareness) roll against a difficulty of the Solar's Essence to realize she made the attack. Failed rolls leave the observer uncertain who struck. This does not conceal the wound itself, only the attacker's identity and position.

The threshold for the awareness check decreases by one for each additional activation of this Charm in the same scene. Additionally, to all observers who fail the check, the attack appears to originate from a direction named by the Solar when activating this Charm.
